flags.message: Upstream supremecourt.gov docket JSON (record/snapshots/2026-11-12.json) lists LowerCourt as 'United States Bankruptcy Appellate Panel for the 10th Circuit' for case number (26-2404), whereas record/documents/application.txt and Fourth Circuit No. 26-2404 (In re: Paul Schultz, Oct. 22, 2026) confirm the application arises from the United States Court of Appeals for the Fourth Circuit (submitted to Chief Justice Roberts as Fourth Circuit Justice).
